# Field day dry run (SYNTHETIC)

**SYNTHETIC telemetry and weather; hidden robot shares the model structure (dry run, not field data).** Generated by `examples/field_day_demo.py`.

Hidden robot: `clearpath_jackal` with absorptance x1.3 and shell to interior conductance x0.6.
Calibration on day 1: hold out error 0.31 K after fitting, 3.99 K with the prior. The code labels a calibrated profile L2; on synthetic telemetry that label carries no evidence and every shipped profile stays L0.

## Validation: clearpath_jackal (FAIL)

**SYNTHETIC telemetry and weather; hidden robot shares the model structure (dry run, not field data). Day 2 held out; L0 profile.**

- Telemetry: `synthetic day 2`
- Period: 2026-08-06T02:00:00Z to 2026-08-06T14:00:00Z, 145 rows at 300 s
- Weather source: synthetic
- Profile evidence level at validation: L0
- Criteria (`docs/validation-protocol.md`, V2): RMSE under 2 K on every node, and the model not colder than the measurement by more than 2 K at the peak
- Uncertainty: 64 Monte Carlo samples over parameter provenance, weather taken as measured
- This record must not have been used for calibration.

| Node | Samples | RMSE (K) | Mean bias (K) | Measured peak (degC) | Predicted peak (degC) | Peak margin (K) | 95 % quantile peak (degC) | Peak within quantile | RMSE | Peak |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| t_shell_c | 144 | 2.43 | -2.31 | 62.1 | 59.5 | -2.6 | 65.2 | yes | FAIL | FAIL |
| t_interior_c | 144 | 4.38 | -4.24 | 70.3 | 64.8 | -5.5 | 74.4 | yes | FAIL | FAIL |
| t_battery_c | 144 | 4.27 | -4.09 | 70.0 | 64.7 | -5.3 | 72.6 | yes | FAIL | FAIL |
| t_compute_c | 144 | 4.39 | -4.22 | 77.2 | 72.2 | -5.0 | 81.6 | yes | FAIL | FAIL |

Overall: **FAIL**. A FAIL is a result, not an error: report it with the preregistered prediction (`docs/prediction-template.md`) and do not tune the profile on this record.
